description: Source file implementing utility functions for camera session configuration, including resolution mode selection and capability support checks within the Android camera framework.

methods.name: getAppropriateModeTag
methods.description: Returns the appropriate mode tag based on default tag and resolution preference.

methods.name: supportsUltraHighResolutionCapture
methods.description: Checks if the device supports ultra high resolution capture either via capability flags or key support.

methods.name: getArrayWidthAndHeight
methods.description: Retrieves width and height from camera metadata for a specified array tag.
